harness_change: The probe imports only IndexerClient and the nCore adapter. On the before side that import chain never loads app.config; on the after side base_indexer_definition imports it (for indexer_torrent_max_bytes), so the after process also carries app.config and its 35 dependent modules (pydantic-settings, dotenv, ...). The production server always has app.config loaded at startup, so this one-time cost is not caused by the change in production. v4 runs the unchanged probe.py/giant.py through preload_probe.py/preload_giant.py, which import app.config first, identically on the before and after side.
